title: Step on an auxiliary configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean alphabet and let $y$ be a finite Boolean input. For any simulated state $q$, input-head position $p$ among the $|y|+2$ positions, three auxiliary tape contents and head positions, and output word, the tabulating machine's step from the auxiliary configuration with state $q$ equals the result of applying its tabulated transition for $q$, using the scanned input symbol and the symbols read from the three auxiliary tapes (with all simulated work tapes blank).
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Turing machine M with Boolean alphabet
An input-head position p among |y|+2 positions
Three auxiliary tape contents τ₀, τ₁, τ₂
Three auxiliary head positions z₀, z₁, z₂
